headline: Brazil's B3 Benchmark Falls 2.68% Ahead of Vale Earnings and Economic Data
summary: Brazil's main stock index dropped 2.68% on Wednesday as investors awaited domestic inflation and employment releases. Mining giant Vale is scheduled to report quarterly results after market close.
why: The B3 index reflects market sentiment across Latin America's largest economy, where index heavyweights like iron ore producer Vale heavily drive performance.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Brazilian stocks faced broad selling as markets positioned ahead of critical macroeconomic indicators and Vale earnings.

why_moved: Equities declined 2.68% as markets weighed macroeconomic uncertainty ahead of national inflation and jobs data alongside major corporate earnings.
